description: NEGATIVE FIXTURE — THE CONTENT BELOW IS DELIBERATELY INVENTED AND MUST BE REJECTED. Every clause in eligibilityData.additionalFacts, and every populated field in caseData, asserts something the Hawaii sources for this track do not supply. HRS § 706-622.9(4) relief is not automatic: two of the four provisos are findings the court makes, and the substance-abuse-treatment fallback is a discretionary grant. The source prescribes no fee for the stage-one motion and the Judiciary publishes none; Haw. R. Penal P. 49(a) service happens after filing, so a stage-one motion can never recite it as done; the prosecuting attorney's position is unknown at filing; and the case number, judge and OTN are read from the participant's own court record, not asserted by the packet. This fixture states all of them anyway, plus a fabricated HRS § 706-622.95. runPleadingQa PASSES content of this kind — it checks relief vocabulary, template grade/lifecycle and the footer, and cannot see invented content — so the verifier's invention and protected-field detectors are what must reject it. The Grade E templateGrade override is retained so the QA gate is exercised as well.
